files.reason: Compounded calendar/fiscal bucket construction, signed win/loss streaks, compensated gains/losses, payoff/profit/CPC and decisive-period Kelly calculations with nonfinite result fields.
Online beta/Jensen/fit/Student-t uncertainty, active-return/capture/Treynor/M-squared formulas, compensated sliding OLS recovery and materially different result-wire adapters.
CLI invokes shared schema generator on explicit analytics registry; no estimator, financial default or numerical model is selected.
Common-sample normalized Pearson Gram matrix, all-column eligibility, bounded endpoint normalization, final PSD checks and validated observation-provenance carrier without repair.
The annualize output-unit flag default; financially used frequency, benchmark, cash, MAR, confidence and window inputs are supplied explicitly.
Log-wealth peak path, threshold episode/recovery segmentation, date durations, worst-episode order, path indices and drawdown reward ratios.
Exact binary-rational reconstruction of paired moments, cancellation-sensitive OLS/Pearson quantities and requested rational/square-root outputs before binary64 rounding; no estimator substitution.
Crate module/feature declarations and public re-exports; no separate runtime estimator beyond the owned implementations.
Excess/total response selection, ignored-cash rejection, factor dimensions/finite checks, intercept SVD regression, response-scaled goodness of fit and residual-risk output validation.
Public active-span aggregation, geometric relative wealth, excess-cash alignment, fiscal lookbacks, period grouping, benchmark drawdown difference and automatic correlation repair selection.
Public pair-overlap regression/capture/relative-risk dispatch, minimum sample guards, rolling ticker/window validation and exact factor-slice caller contract.
Input domain and contiguous missing spans, price conversion, synthetic initial dates, default benchmark/frequency, active windows, intersections, cache rebuilds and parameter validation.
Price-versus-return panel contract and nonfinite-to-null/null-to-NaN input conversion that changes the distinction between missing and infinite values.
Public rolling method selection, ticker/window rejection, active per-ticker dates and frequency/MAR/cash propagation into numerical kernels.
Public scalar metric guards/composition, dated-CAGR defaults, cashless Martin/worst-n Burke, confidence validation, historical summary selection and table assembly.
Restored-state benchmark/window/spans validation through assembly, saved-window application and recomputation of financial drawdown caches.
Column-normalized full-rank SVD, finite unscaling and holdings-normalized equality correction with explicit rank/satisfaction/degeneracy tolerances and failure paths.
Positive price-ratio conversion, effective cash conversion, aligned excess returns, compensated log wealth and finite-wipeout floor semantics.
Nonfinite-first ratio and annualized ratio policies including signed infinities/zero for finite zero denominators, plus risk re-exports.
Dated CAGR basis and parsing, calendar propagation, arithmetic/sample risk, downside partial moments, reward ratios and annual-horizon modified CF Sharpe.
Sliding log/mean-M2/downside kernels, compensation/rebuild/clamp constants, singleton outputs and explicit dated-series nonfinite wire behavior.
R-7 historical quantile dispatch, exact fractional tail ES, tail ratio, online adjusted fourth moments, Gaussian/CF horizon scaling and warning-only Gaussian fallback.
Explicit analytics root schema artifact registry and output descriptions; estimator/default/validation behavior is owned by the listed runtime types.
